video_title: Are the 76ers the biggest threat to the Knicks after acquiring Jaylen Brown? | Get Up

quotes.speaker: Shams Charania
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James is currently evaluating his free agency options
quotes.excerpt: LeBron James is not in an immediate rush. He is evaluating his options.
quotes.quote: LeBron James is not in an immediate rush. He is in Ohio right now spending family time, but also him, his agent Rich Paul, they are in fact-finding, information-gathering stages right now. So you absorb the info and I do expect over the coming days, LeBron James, Rich Paul will take the next step in their conversations with teams.

quotes.speaker: Vincent Goodwill
quotes.summary_phrase: Denver Nuggets are a top destination for LeBron James
quotes.excerpt: The Denver Nuggets really intrigue me. The thought of playing with Nicola Jokic.
quotes.quote: The Denver Nuggets really intrigue me. The thought of playing with Nicola Jokic, who is still at the top of his game, Jamal Murray, Aaron Gordon, all those guys. They haven't been in the championship conversation for quite a long time. It all depends on what LeBron James really wants. He can fit into any situation and any environment and make them better than what they are.

quotes.speaker: Monica McNutt
quotes.summary_phrase: The competitive gap between the 76ers and Knicks is closing
quotes.excerpt: When you look at these starting lineups, the gap is not that wide.
quotes.quote: When you look at these starting lineups, the gap is not that wide. And that is not necessarily a commentary on the Knicks, but we are now on our eighth different champion in a span of eight years. Front offices and the CBA have all aligned so that teams are putting themselves in the best position to be successful and challenging the idea that we can come up with repeat champions.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown's play style may not fit the 76ers
quotes.excerpt: Jaylen Brown prefers to play a ball-dominant style. I think Philadelphia has a lot to figure out.
quotes.quote: I am not sure that LeBron James would be a great fit in Philadelphia because there is only one basketball. I assume he wants to touch it every once in a while. Philadelphia made a significant upgrade in terms of talent, but part of the reason that Boston put Jaylen Brown on the trade block is because the Celtics were consistently better with him off the floor than on. Jaylen Brown prefers to play a ball-dominant style. I think Philadelphia has a lot to figure out before we assume that they have closed the gap on the top teams in the East.

quotes.speaker: Vincent Goodwill
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James could fit into several championship-contending rosters
quotes.excerpt: You can see him fitting in with Golden State. You can see him fitting in with Miami.
quotes.quote: There is no complete team in the NBA. That is the gift and the curse of parity, but there are ways that you can look at it and say, if you are willing to be competitive, not necessarily guarantee a championship, you can see him fitting in with Golden State. You can see him fitting in with Stephen Curry and Draymond Green. You can see him fitting in with the Miami Heat and that pre-existing roster of Giannis Antetokounmpo and Bam Adebayo and Bobby Portis and Tim Hardaway Jr. I look at the Miami Heat and I see LeBron James being able to be a third option and not having to do the heavy lifting.

quotes.speaker: Monica McNutt
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James's versatility allows him to fit any roster
quotes.excerpt: He is the greatest that the game has to offer. He will fit anywhere he decides.
quotes.quote: He is the greatest that the game has to offer. He will fit anywhere he decides he wants to be because that is the nature of his game.

quotes.speaker: Shams Charania
quotes.summary_phrase: The 76ers are now a legitimate threat to land LeBron James
quotes.excerpt: A few days ago, the 76ers didn't have Jaylen Brown. So now they do.
quotes.quote: A few days ago, the 76ers didn't have Jaylen Brown. So now they do. They did it in stunning fashion and so now they have to be on the radar of LeBron James. The Warriors, going into free agency, they dreamt up a grand plan of Draymond Green, Stephen Curry, LeBron James, but the big domino with them is trying to get a player like an Anthony Davis. So you can bring in LeBron James and Anthony Davis as a package deal. Short of that, they are not really looked at right now at the top of this list, but things can change.

quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown's reaction to the trade process
quotes.excerpt: There is the possibility of the money talk. There is the possibility of the respect talk.

text_blocks.speaker: Vincent Goodwill
text_blocks.text: There is so much going on there. There is the possibility of the money talk. There is the possibility of the respect talk. There is the analytics discussion. All of those things are things that he could have addressed and probably they did address at some point over the last day or so because there has been so much discussion about him. Does he make teammates better? Why is he not an analytics darling? Is he going to be worth the two-year $140 million extension? The bottom line is this, the Boston Celtics initially put him out there for Giannis Antetokounmpo. I think he understood that.

text_blocks.speaker: Monica McNutt
text_blocks.text: Did he understand and appreciate the conversation after that? Clearly the answer is no, and because it is Boston and Boston always has this history of how they treat players for good or bad, it is going to be something that comes up with a guy like Jaylen Brown who is outspoken, who is unapologetic, and who is very authentic in how he approaches things.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Jayson Tatum's silence speaks volumes regarding the trade
quotes.excerpt: As was the case with our technical difficulties, the silence speaks volumes.
quotes.quote: As was the case with our technical difficulties, the silence speaks volumes. It is deafening silence coming from Jayson Tatum. And look, there was this Tatum or Brown, Tatum versus Brown thing really for the whole time they were together. They still won a championship, despite the fact that Jayson Tatum tried to throw the stink bomb in the Celtics locker room with, 'Hey, Jaylen Brown's their best player.' Jayson Tatum knew what he was doing. It didn't work then, but Brown threw a stink bomb in the locker room at the end of this season, 'Hey, this was my favorite season,' basically saying he loved being the man. This was after they got knocked out in the first round.

quotes.summary_phrase: The media's bias toward Jayson Tatum over Jaylen Brown
quotes.excerpt: We like Jayson Tatum a lot more than we like Jaylen Brown.

text_blocks.speaker: Monica McNutt
text_blocks.text: Here is the thing. On the one hand, we respect these guys, the upper echelon of the league, the All-Star caliber of the league for having these maniacal, unsatiated egos. And then all of a sudden, we are going to punish him because he acknowledged that he had an opportunity to be the guy and said he had a lot of fun with the process? I think it is unfair to have it both ways. I am not going to punish him for those honest statements, because I believe that if the shoe was on the other foot and Jayson Tatum is having a fantastic year without his running mate, but it is a great year, like, why can't you acknowledge the success that you have and it not automatically be an indictment on your teammate?

text_blocks.speaker: Vincent Goodwill
text_blocks.text: You are absolutely right, Monica. If this was Jayson Tatum, we would have felt a lot better about assigning that award to him, but that is because we as the media and everybody else, we like Jayson Tatum a lot more than we like Jaylen Brown. And that is to no fault of anybody.
